lines.t: (Verse 1)
I thought I had stopped my wrongdoing.
I thought I had left my pride behind.
I thought I was done with all the sin,
All the filth I had within.
I know no one is perfect,
No one except You,
But I thought I could at least remain
Faithful to You.
(Pre-Chorus)
I know I did wrong,
And I repented.
But I seem to have again.
(Chorus)
Forgive me, Lord.
For all the wrong I've done.
For every sin I've tried to outrun.
The tears stream down my face,
My heart feels broken in two.
I just have to tell all my wrongdoings
To You.
YahuShua,
Help me get pass all this,
I give You my heart, humble and submiss.
(Verse 2)
I thought I had stepped out of line.
Of all the darkness that tried to define,
Me.
But soon shadows were all I could see.
YahuShua,
This is not where I wanted to be.
(Bridge)
I cry unto You,
Lord.
To forgive all that I've done before,
Lord.
(Chorus)
Forgive me, Lord.
For all the wrong I've done.
For every sin I've tried to outrun.
The tears stream down my face,
My heart feels broken in two.
I just have to tell all my wrongdoings
To You.
YahuShua,
Help me get pass all this,
I give You my heart, humble and submiss.
(Outro)
YahuShua...
I'm sorry.
I'm sorry.
